blocks.html: Share RMoments That Shine and Get a Chance to Win the One RLC Experience Package

Across our malls, hotels, residences, offices, and destination estates, Robinsons Land creates spaces where gatherings are more meaningful and every shared moment adds light to the holidays. Share your experience at any Robinsons Land development on Facebook or Instagram and get a chance to win exclusive rewards. This year, 10 winners will be chosen to receive the One RLC Experience.
What is the One RLC Experience Package?

Enjoy a 3-day, 2-night stay at Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria in a suite for five, complete with a breakfast buffet. Indulge with ₱5,000 worth of Robinsons Hotels & Resorts gift cards, redeemable for dining or hotel services. Unwind with ₱2,000 worth of Robinsons Movieworld ticket vouchers, and find inspiration in flexible co-working spaces with ₱2,000 worth of work.able vouchers. Shop to your heart’s content with ₱2,500 worth of Robinsons Malls shopping vouchers, valid across all Robinsons Retail affiliates (i.e., Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Appliances, True Value, Handyman, Daiso, Toys R Us, and more) and take home exclusive merchandise items from RLC Residences, Robinsons Destination Estate, and Robinsons Logistix and Industrials, Inc.

items: Visit any Robinsons Malls, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, RLC Residences, Robinsons Offices, or Robinsons Destination Estates this holiday season.
Capture your most meaningful holiday moments in a reel.
Explain how RLC made your holidays brighter in the caption.
Post your reel publicly on Facebook or Instagram. Tag @officialrobinsonsland, and use the hashtag #RMomentsThatShine.
Entries must be posted beginning November 18, 2025 to January 5, 2026.
Entries will be chosen based on the following content criteria:
Relevance to the “Together, We Build Brighter Holidays” message - 30%
Winners will be announced on Robinsons Land’s Facebook and Instagram pages and notified via Direct Message (DM) or Private Message (PM) on the platform used for entry.
December 13, 2025 – First batch of 5 winners (entries posted from November 18 to December 11)
January 7, 2026 – Second batch of 5 winners (entries posted from December 12 to January 5)
Winners must respond with the required details within 30 days of notification, or the prize will be forfeited in favor of Robinsons Land.
All individuals are eligible to join the contest, except employees and affiliates of Robinsons Land Corporation.
